models.title: Household net saving including pension-entitlement adjustment
models.summary: The Canadian saving measure subtracts final consumption from disposable income and adds the pension-entitlement adjustment.

relationship.original_equation: Household net saving = household disposable income - final consumption + change in pension entitlements

relationship.translation_notes: All ports have the same currency dimension and support. This three-term Canadian household identity is distinct from a simple income-minus-outlays profile. Pension asset revaluation gains are not automatically the pension adjustment.
